profile: subgraph: A graph H is called a subgraph of G if every vertex and edge of H belong to G. Thus all vertices and edges of H are contained in G.

draft.profile: subgraph: A graph H is called a subgraph of G if every vertex and edge of H belong to G. Consequently, all vertices and edges of a subgraph are contained within the original graph, with no additional vertices or edges beyond those in G.
